title: India, 2010
tagline: The first Aadhaar number, a new rupee sign and the Commonwealth Games.

locale.persona: an urban household in India (typical, not one named family)
locale.placeNameNote: Period place names with today's name in brackets on first mention, e.g. Bombay (now Mumbai).

morningRoutine.detail: The first Aadhaar number, a 12-digit identity linked to a photograph, ten fingerprints and two iris scans, was issued in September 2010.
The Government of India presented the new rupee sign on 15 July 2010, designed by D. Udaya Kumar after an open competition.
Dabangg was the highest-grossing Hindi film of 2010.

source.label: Wikipedia: List of Hindi films of 2010

morningRoutine.detail: India won 101 medals at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi, 38 gold, 27 silver and 36 bronze, second in the table.

source.label: Wikipedia: India at the 2010 Commonwealth Games

technology.name: The rupee sign
technology.description: The Government of India presented the new rupee sign on 15 July 2010, designed by D. Udaya Kumar after an open competition; it is based on the Devanagari letter ra with a double horizontal line, and later received the Unicode codepoint U+20B9.

technology.name: The first Aadhaar number
technology.description: The first Aadhaar number, a 12-digit unique identity linked to a photograph, ten fingerprints and two iris scans, was issued in September 2010.

technology.name: A cryogenic engine fails on its first flight
technology.description: On 15 April 2010 the first GSLV flight with an indigenous cryogenic upper stage failed: the liquid-hydrogen turbopump failed, the stage fired for about 1.5 seconds and the GSAT-4 satellite was lost in the Bay of Bengal.
